# Docs

- Framework: The docs framework

  - **Introduction**
  - [Quick Start](https://fumadocs.dev/docs): Getting Started with Fumadocs
  - [What is Fumadocs](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/what-is-fumadocs): Introducing Fumadocs, a docs framework that you can break.
  - [Comparisons](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/comparisons): How is Fumadocs different from other existing frameworks?
  - Manual Installation
    - [Manual Installation](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation): Add Fumadocs to existing projects.
    - [Next.js](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation/next): Setup Fumadocs on Next.js.
    - [React Router](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation/react-router): Setup Fumadocs on React Router.
    - [Tanstack Start](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation/tanstack-start): Setup Fumadocs on Tanstack Start.
    - [Waku](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/manual-installation/waku): Setup Fumadocs on Waku.
  - Guides
    - [Guides](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides): Useful guides for extending Fumadocs.
    - [Access Control](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/access-control): Limit the access of content.
    - [Customize UI](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/customize-ui): A complete guide on how to customize Fumadocs UI.
    - [Export EPUB](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/export-epub): Export your documentation to EPUB format for e-readers
    - [Export PDF](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/export-pdf): Export docs pages as PDF documents
    - [RSS Feed](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/guides/rss): Generate a RSS feed for your docs/blog.

  - **Writing**
  - [Page Slugs & Page Tree](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/page-conventions): A shared convention for organizing your documents
  - Markdown
    - [Markdown](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/markdown): How to write documents
    - [Math](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/markdown/math): Writing math equations in Markdown/MDX.
    - [Mermaid](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/markdown/mermaid): Rendering diagrams in your docs
    - [Twoslash](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/markdown/twoslash): Use Typescript Twoslash in your docs

  - **Configurations**
  - [Navigation](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/navigation): Configure navigation in your Fumadocs app.
  - Deploying
    - [Deploying](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/deploying): Deploy your Fumadocs app
    - [Static Build](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/deploying/static): Output static website with Fumadocs.
  - Internationalization
    - [Internationalization](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/internationalization): Support multiple languages in your documentation
    - [Next.js](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/internationalization/next): Support i18n routing on your Next.js + Fumadocs app
    - [React Router](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/internationalization/react-router): Support i18n routing on your React Router + Fumadocs app.
    - [Tanstack Start](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/internationalization/tanstack-start): Support i18n routing on your Tanstack Start + Fumadocs app.
  - Search
    - [Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search): Implement document search in your docs
    - [Orama (default)](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/orama): The default search engine powered by Orama.
    - [Algolia](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/algolia): Using Algolia with Fumadocs UI.
    - [FlexSearch](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/flexsearch): A fast & minimal search engine.
    - [Mixedbread](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/mixedbread): Using Mixedbread with Fumadocs UI.
    - [Orama Cloud](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/orama-cloud): Using Orama Cloud with Fumadocs UI.
    - [Typesense](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/typesense): Using Typesense with Fumadocs UI.
    - [Custom Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/search/custom): For other search solutions.

  - **Integrations**
  - [Feedback](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/feedback): Receive feedback from your users
  - [AI & LLMs](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/llms): Integrate AI functionality to Fumadocs.
  - [Validate Links](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/validate-links): Ensure your links are correct.
  - Content Generators
    - [Obsidian](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/obsidian): Render your Obsidian vaults in Fumadocs.
    - [Python](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/python): Generate docs from Python
    - [Typescript](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/typescript): Generate docs from Typescript definitions
  - AsyncAPI
    - [AsyncAPI](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/asyncapi): Generating docs for AsyncAPI schema.
    - [createAsyncAPIPage()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/asyncapi/api-page): The component for rendering AsyncAPI docs content
    - [generateFiles()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/asyncapi/generate-files): Generate pages from AsyncAPI schema.
    - [createAsyncAPI()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/asyncapi/server): The AsyncAPI server instance.
  - Content Source
    - [Content Source](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/content): Integrate different content sources with Fumadocs.
    - [Build Your Own](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/content/custom): Build your own content source for Fumadocs.
    - [Local Markdown](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/content/local-md): Content source for local Markdown content.
    - [MDX Remote](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/content/mdx-remote): Compiled Markdown/MDX content on demand.
    - [Sanity](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/content/sanity): Official integration for Sanity.
  - OG Image Generation
    - [OG Image Generation](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/og): Generate dynamic preview image for docs pages
    - [next/og](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/og/next): Usage with Next.js Metadata API.
    - [Takumi](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/og/takumi): Integrate Takumi for framework agnostic and fast metadata image generation.
  - OpenAPI
    - [OpenAPI](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/openapi): Generating docs for OpenAPI schema.
    - [createOpenAPIPage()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/openapi/api-page): The component for rendering OpenAPI docs content
    - [generateFiles()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/openapi/generate-files): Generate pages from OpenAPI schema.
    - [createOpenAPI()](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/openapi/server): The OpenAPI server instance.
  - Story
    - [Story](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/story): Display components with controls.
    - [Next.js](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/story/next): Configure Fumadocs Story on Next.js.
    - [Vite](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/integrations/story/vite): Configure Fumadocs Story for Vite-based frameworks.
- Fumadocs UI: The default theme

  - **Introduction**
  - [Overview](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui): The default theme of Fumadocs
  - [Component Library](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/component-library): The underlying headless component library.
  - [Themes](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/theme): Add Theme to Fumadocs UI

  - **References**
  - [Search UI](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/search): The UI for document search
  - [Translations](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/translations): Adding Translations to UI
  - Components
    - [Components](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components): Additional components to improve your docs
    - [Accordion](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/accordion): Add Accordions to your documentation
    - [Auto Type Table](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/auto-type-table): Auto-generated type table
    - [Banner](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/banner): Add a banner to your site
    - [Code Block](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/codeblock): Displaying Shiki highlighted code blocks
    - [Code Block (Dynamic)](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/dynamic-codeblock): A codeblock that also highlights code
    - [Files](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/files): Display file structure in your documentation
    - [GitHub Info](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/github-info): Display your GitHub repository information
    - [Graph View](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/graph-view): A graph of all pages.
    - [Zoomable Image](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/image-zoom): Allow zoom-in images in your documentation
    - [Inline TOC](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/inline-toc): Add Inline TOC into your documentation
    - [Steps](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/steps): Adding steps to your docs
    - [Tabs](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/tabs): A Tabs component built with Radix UI, with additional features such as persistent and shared value.
    - [Type Table](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/components/type-table): A table for documenting types
  - Layouts
    - [Layouts](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts): A list of layout components.

    - **Configurations**
    - [Layout Links](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/links): Navigation configurations on all layouts.
    - [Navbar](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/nav): Navbar/header configurations.

    - **Components**
    - [Docs Layout](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/docs): The layout of documentation
    - [Flux Layout](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/flux): An aggressively minimal layout for docs
    - [Home Layout](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/home-layout): Shared layout for other pages
    - [Notebook Layout](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/notebook): A compact version of Docs Layout
    - [Docs Page](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/page): A page in your documentation
    - [Root Provider](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/ui/layouts/root-provider): The context provider of Fumadocs UI.
- Fumadocs Core: The headless library

  - **Guide**
  - [Introduction](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless): Getting started with core library
  - Search
    - [Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search): Configure Search in Fumadocs
    - [Algolia Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/algolia): Integrate Algolia Search with Fumadocs
    - [FlexSearch](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/flexsearch): Fast & minimal document search
    - [Mixedbread](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/mixedbread): Integrate Mixedbread Search with Fumadocs
    - [Orama Cloud](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/orama-cloud): Integrate with Orama Cloud
    - [Built-in Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/orama): Built-in document search of Fumadocs
    - [Trieve Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/trieve): Integrate Trieve Search with Fumadocs
    - [Typesense Search](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/search/typesense): Integrate Typesense Search with Fumadocs

  - **API References**
  - [Page Tree](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/page-tree): The structure of page tree.
  - Internationalization
    - [Configuration](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/internationalization/config): Shared i18n configuration
    - [Middleware](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/internationalization/middleware): Next.js proxy for implementing i18n routing
  - Components
    - [Components](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/components): Blocks for your docs
    - [Breadcrumb](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/components/breadcrumb): The navigation component at the top of the screen
    - [Link](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/components/link): A Link component that handles external links
    - [TOC](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/components/toc): Table of Contents
  - Utilities
    - [Utilities](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils): Utilities to provide extra functionality to your docs
    - [Get TOC](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils/get-toc): Parse Table of contents from markdown/mdx content
    - [Last Modified Time](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils/git-last-edit): Get the last edit time of a file in Github repository
    - [Negotiation](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils/negotiation): Tiny wrapper for negotiation features.
    - [Page Tree Utils](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils/page-tree): Common utilities to interact with page tree.
    - [Shiki (Internal)](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/utils/shiki): Manage the Shiki instances.
  - MDX Plugins
    - [MDX Plugins](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx): Useful remark & rehype plugins for your docs.
    - [Headings](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/headings): Process headings from your document
    - [Package Install](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/install): Generate code blocks for installing packages
    - [Rehype Code](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/rehype-code): Code syntax highlighter
    - [Remark Admonition](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-admonition): Use Admonition in Fumadocs
    - [Remark Image](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-image): Adding size attributes to images.
    - [Remark LLMs](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-llms): Generate markdown for LLM consumption with customizable placeholders
    - [Remark Files](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-mdx-files): Generate files from codeblocks.
    - [Remark NPM](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-npm): Generate code blocks for package managers
    - [Remark Steps](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-steps): Generate steps from headings
    - [Remark TS to JS](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/remark-ts2js): A remark plugin to transform TypeScript codeblocks into two tabs of codeblock with its JavaScript variant.
    - [Remark Structure](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/mdx/structure): Extract information from your documents, useful for implementing document search

  - **Sources**
  - Loader API
    - [Loader API](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/source-api): Turn content sources into a unified interface
    - [Loader Plugins](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/source-api/plugins): Extend Loader API
    - [Source](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/source-api/source): Setup sources for Loader API
  - [Page Slugs & Page Tree](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/page-conventions): Customize generated page slugs and page tree.
  - [Content Collections](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/headless/content-collections): Use Content Collections for Fumadocs
- Fumadocs MDX: The official content source

  - **Guide**
  - [Getting Started](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx): Introducing Fumadocs MDX, the official content source of Fumadocs.
  - [Performance](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/performance): The performance of Fumadocs MDX
  - Accessing Collections
    - [Accessing Collections](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/entry): Access collection outputs from entry files.
    - [Browser Entry](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/entry/browser): Access collections from browser/client environment.
    - [Dynamic Entry](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/entry/dynamic): Accessing your collections with on-demand compilation.
    - [Import MDX Files](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/entry/import): Importing MDX files directly.
    - [Server Entry](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/entry/server): Accessing collection outputs from server.

  - **Integrations**
  - [Next.js](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/next): Use Fumadocs MDX with Next.js
  - [Vite](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/vite): Use Fumadocs MDX with Vite
  - Runtime Loader
    - [Runtime Loader](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/loader): Fumadocs MDX loader integration.
    - [Bun](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/loader/bun): Access content in Bun.
    - [Node.js](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/loader/node): Access content in Node.js runtime.

  - **Configuration**
  - [Collections](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/collections): Collection of content data for your app
  - [Global Options](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/global): Customize Fumadocs MDX
  - [MDX Presets](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/mdx): Customize the default configurations for MDX processor.

  - **Features**
  - [Include](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/include): Reuse content from other files.
  - [Last Modified Time](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/last-modified): Output the last modified time of a document
  - [Lazy Loading](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/async): Configure lazy loading on collection outputs.
  - [Generate Types](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/typegen): Generate types without running dev/build server
  - [Workspace](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/mdx/workspace): Use Fumadocs MDX in multiple workspace.
- Fumadocs CLI: CLI tools for docs & automation
  - [User Guide](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/cli): The CLI tool that automates setups and installs components.
  - [create-fumadocs-app](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/cli/create-fumadocs-app): The CLI to create new Fumadocs apps
  - [Preview](https://fumadocs.dev/docs/cli/preview): A light tool to view Markdown files.
